title: Typed nested property values, validation and size limit
narrative: As a developer, I want typed nested properties with precise numbers, duplicate-key rejection, schemaless labels and a size limit so that data round-trips safely.

evals.name: typed values, duplicates, schemaless
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test graph_model -- typed_values duplicate_keys schemaless

evals.name: size limit boundary and live reconfiguration
evals.command: cargo test -p dscore-server --test limits -- size_16mib_accepted_16mib_plus_1_rejected live_reconfigure

evals.name: max-size documents under write load
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- limits doc-size --size-mib 16 --workload write-heavy --assert-no-oom --assert-p99-write-ms 200
